Run the ashways where maps burn out.

Level 3: Ashway Sprint (BBTTCC)

Lead travel in Wasteland/Desert: reduce Logistics OP by 1 once per travel; you + PB allies gain +10 ft for 1 hour.

Level 3: Ghost Stamp

Bonus action cache mark; allies starting within 5 ft can Dash as bonus action this turn (PB/long rest).

Level 6: Dust Veil

Move 20 ft on your turn → ranged attacks vs you at disadvantage until next turn.

Level 10: Wake of Routes

Spaces you crossed this round ignore difficult terrain for followers until their turn ends.

Level 14: Dead Drop

1/long rest: deliver a Tiny item to a tagged cache within 600 ft as a bonus action if a continuous route exists.
